rows.detail_main_html:
Healing Touch I

Paladin · Level 14

Effect

Heals your defensive target for 461.

Damage, healing and hate in Vanguard scale with your stats, skills and level — the figures above are the ability's own, not what a particular character will see.

Notes

The Cleric has a Healing Touch of its own, and it is a different ability rather than the same one shared. Compared at matching levels the Cleric's heals for more every time -- 23% more at rank I, narrowing to 10% by rank V -- which fits the Paladin being the heavier-armoured, lesser-healing half of the pair.

Energy efficiency differs between the two classes by a near-constant factor. Healing per point of energy spent runs 1.9 to 2.0 times better on the Paladin than on the Cleric at every matching level -- the Paladin heals less per cast, as expected, but costs less than half as much energy to do it. A ratio that steady across five ranks looks deliberate rather than accidental, but it is worth confirming which side carries the intended numbers.

14
Scorches all undead opponents within 15m for 678 to 716 damage and blinds them, reducing accuracy and movement by 70% for 20 seconds or 1 hit. Energy Cost: 0

rows.detail_main_html:
Judgment of the Impure II

Also recorded as Judgement of the Impure II

Paladin · Level 20

Effect

The punishment to be meted out to the impure. Your target takes 876 to 925 damage over 21 sec. as they are purified by fire. Only one judgment may be active on a target.

As it was earlier

What guides written while Vanguard was running recorded for this ability. Kept beside the current figures rather than replacing them — the game was rebalanced across its life, so both are right for their own year.

Level in 2007-2008
20
The punishment metes out to the impure. Your target takes 418 to 443 damage over 21 seconds as they are purified by fire. Only one judgment may be active on a target. Energy Cost: 87

Ten Ton Hammer class guides, 2007-2008 · every ability that changed

Damage, healing and hate in Vanguard scale with your stats, skills and level — the figures above are the ability's own, not what a particular character will see.

Notes

The punishment metes out to the impure. Your target takes 418 to 443 damage over 21 seconds as they are purified by fire. Only one judgment may be active on a target.

Previously recorded by the vgoplayers wiki as: “Damage over time spell (21 sec) (only allowed one Judgment at a time)” (https://web.archive.org/web/20211025003636id_/https://vgoplayers.com/wiki/index.php/Paladin)

Protector's Fury II

Paladin · Level 20

Effect

Deals 300% weapon damage plus 111 to 119 and forces the attacker of your defensive target to attack you for 2 attacks or 4 seconds. The same opponent may only be target-forced once every 30 sec.

As it was earlier

What guides written while Vanguard was running recorded for this ability. Kept beside the current figures rather than replacing them — the game was rebalanced across its life, so both are right for their own year.

Level in 2007-2008
20
Deals 300% weapon damage plus 116 to 127 and forces the attacker of your defensive target to attack you instead. If you use a rescue when you are below 20% health you gain a virtue point. Energy Cost: 0

Ten Ton Hammer class guides, 2007-2008 · every ability that changed

Damage, healing and hate in Vanguard scale with your stats, skills and level — the figures above are the ability's own, not what a particular character will see.

Damage, healing and hate in Vanguard scale with your stats, skills and level — the figures above are the ability's own, not what a particular character will see.

Notes

The Cleric has a Healing Touch of its own, and it is a different ability rather than the same one shared. Compared at matching levels the Cleric's heals for more every time -- 23% more at rank I, narrowing to 10% by rank V -- which fits the Paladin being the heavier-armoured, lesser-healing half of the pair.

Energy efficiency differs between the two classes by a near-constant factor. Healing per point of energy spent runs 1.9 to 2.0 times better on the Paladin than on the Cleric at every matching level -- the Paladin heals less per cast, as expected, but costs less than half as much energy to do it. A ratio that steady across five ranks looks deliberate rather than accidental, but it is worth confirming which side carries the intended numbers.

Healing Touch III

Paladin · Level 30

Effect

Heals your defensive target for 923.

Damage, healing and hate in Vanguard scale with your stats, skills and level — the figures above are the ability's own, not what a particular character will see.

Notes

The Cleric has a Healing Touch of its own, and it is a different ability rather than the same one shared. Compared at matching levels the Cleric's heals for more every time -- 23% more at rank I, narrowing to 10% by rank V -- which fits the Paladin being the heavier-armoured, lesser-healing half of the pair.

Energy efficiency differs between the two classes by a near-constant factor. Healing per point of energy spent runs 1.9 to 2.0 times better on the Paladin than on the Cleric at every matching level -- the Paladin heals less per cast, as expected, but costs less than half as much energy to do it. A ratio that steady across five ranks looks deliberate rather than accidental, but it is worth confirming which side carries the intended numbers.

rows.detail_main_html:
Healing Touch IV

Paladin · Level 38

Effect

Heals your defensive target for 1177.

Damage, healing and hate in Vanguard scale with your stats, skills and level — the figures above are the ability's own, not what a particular character will see.

Notes

The Cleric has a Healing Touch of its own, and it is a different ability rather than the same one shared. Compared at matching levels the Cleric's heals for more every time -- 23% more at rank I, narrowing to 10% by rank V -- which fits the Paladin being the heavier-armoured, lesser-healing half of the pair.

Energy efficiency differs between the two classes by a near-constant factor. Healing per point of energy spent runs 1.9 to 2.0 times better on the Paladin than on the Cleric at every matching level -- the Paladin heals less per cast, as expected, but costs less than half as much energy to do it. A ratio that steady across five ranks looks deliberate rather than accidental, but it is worth confirming which side carries the intended numbers.

Effect

Heals your defensive target for 1446.

Damage, healing and hate in Vanguard scale with your stats, skills and level — the figures above are the ability's own, not what a particular character will see.

Notes

The Cleric has a Healing Touch of its own, and it is a different ability rather than the same one shared. Compared at matching levels the Cleric's heals for more every time -- 23% more at rank I, narrowing to 10% by rank V -- which fits the Paladin being the heavier-armoured, lesser-healing half of the pair.

Energy efficiency differs between the two classes by a near-constant factor. Healing per point of energy spent runs 1.9 to 2.0 times better on the Paladin than on the Cleric at every matching level -- the Paladin heals less per cast, as expected, but costs less than half as much energy to do it. A ratio that steady across five ranks looks deliberate rather than accidental, but it is worth confirming which side carries the intended numbers.
